title: ValueError in summary.total when sending a scheduled report
body:
ENVIRONMENT:

Lattice version 3.2.6; operating system Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; server region eu-
west-2.

STEPS:

How to trigger it:
- Start by sending a scheduled report.
- Change the system timezone to one ahead of UTC.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

EXPECTED:

No traceback; sending a scheduled report normally takes a few seconds.

ACTUAL:

It fails on a timestamp near midnight. Our machines are set to a timezone ahead
of UTC and the date flips at midnight.

FREQUENCY:

It occurs once a day or so.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/report/schedule.py:67 in run_due
lattice/report/builder.py:139 in build
lattice/report/summary.py:103 in total
ValueError: cannot convert float NaN to integer
